title: Qualify current frontier model providers and a stable capability-based routing registry
baseCommit: 1f99dd5c (KAN-182 VMM-14 head; composes the VMM-04 pre-registration pattern)
whatBuilt: STABLE ADAPTERS: every provider pins an adapter version; the SAME version must be used at qualification AND serve time — a mismatch refuses the route
THRESHOLDS PRE-REGISTERED by the custodian BEFORE profiles/measurements (frozen once measurement exists); measured results bind the thresholds digest

GATES: task quality, latency (p95), per-task cost, English grounding rate, tools support, and MANDATORY accepted data terms (retention/region/trainingUse=none) — a provider without accepted data terms is never qualified for private tasks
NO BRAND RANKING: qualification is thresholds-based per provider; the registry has NO ranking operation (refuse_ranking contract-proven); consumer-chat availability is explicitly irrelevant
CAPABILITY-BASED ROUTING: capability_route returns the deterministic qualified-provider set per capability (teach/reason/build) in fallback order; unqualified providers never route

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 146/146 pass (135 previous + 11 providers)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: Qualification VERDICTS here are measured through SYNTHETIC adapters; real provider measurement (actual API quality/cost/latency/data-terms contracts with named providers) requires hosted access and named-provider agreements and remains a separate gate. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
